vellum_obligation: When the Pulp canvas target adopts Vellum, gradients must accept a CSS colour-interpolation space and hue method and map them to Skia's interpolation enum; unsupported spaces are refused, not approximated. Concretely: every fill and stroke gradient setter (linear, repeating linear, radial, elliptical radial, two-point conical, sweep/conic, repeating conic) honours the canvas's current GradientInterpolation on both the raster and Graphite backends; sRGB stays Skia's kDestination; oklab/oklch map to the non-gamut-mapped kOKLab/kOKLCH, matching Chrome's clipping; and the setter stays appended so existing vtable slots keep their positions.
